alt: Magistrate staring at Wonganghami’s backside as she bends at the mill.
Small clothing slip — vermilion collar off the shoulder while he watches.
Fantasy Wonganghami winks with vermilion cleavage; he is silently tormented.

at: Dancing girls asleep on his chest
alt: Women asleep on his chest; only the translucent Wonganghami holds him.

at: arms out like a broken fighter
alt: Bloodied Hallakgungi sprawled on the yard floor; the third daughter steps over him.
Ants sort millet for Hallakgungi on the mountainside.
Hallakgungi rides Sinrok west through the waters.

at: Blood comes with some of the laughs
alt: Laughing flower: the house laughs itself raw; guest in gray beard smiles.

at: Under the hood his smile stays gentle
alt: Bloodied hall; Hallakgungi’s gentle smile under hood and fake gray beard.

at: Fake gray beard peeled with it
alt: Dramatic unveil — hood and fake gray beard off; third daughter terrifies.

at: lifts her face by the chin
alt: Before the kill he lifts her chin and admires her beauty.

at: names him Hallakgungi before she can breathe right
alt: Hallakgungi is born — Wonganghami names him in the servant room.
